bug_semantics: CWE-476 NULL dereference in is_vm_area_hugepages() (include/linux/vmalloc.h). Under CONFIG_HAVE_ARCH_HUGE_VMALLOC the helper did find_vm_area(addr)->page_order with no NULL check. find_vm_area() returns NULL when the address is not a tracked vmalloc area. At introduction, alloc_large_system_hash() called the helper on a possibly-failed __vmalloc() pointer; later callers (e.g. powerpc change_memory_attr) could also pass a non-area address. Result is a kernel oops / local DoS.
flaw_origin: First write of is_vm_area_hugepages() in include/linux/vmalloc.h in 121e6f3258fe393e22c36f61a319be8a4f2c05ae (mm/vmalloc: hugepage vmalloc mappings). That commit added the unguarded deref return find_vm_area(addr)->page_order > 0. Immediate parent 5d87510de15f31d1b26cffced7bc4d504539a2c7 has the header but neither the helper nor that line. The vulnerable line is unchanged until the 2026 fix. Not a move, refactor, revert, backport, or squash.
